\section[\texorpdfstring{\ta{அடுத்த} (aṭutta)}{அடுத்த (aṭutta)}]{\ta{அடுத்த} (aṭutta) — next, coming}

\label{lesson:TA-C159-atutta}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Tamil for once, then the Tamil for to spend.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ta{அடுத்த}}
\textbf{\ta{அடுத்த}} — \emph{aṭutta} — \textquotedblleft{}next, coming\textquotedblright{}. Tamil's future for \textquotedblleft{}I\textquotedblright{} ends in \textbf{-\ta{வேன்}} or \textbf{-\ta{ப்பேன்}}: \textbf{\ta{அடுத்த} \ta{வாரம்} \ta{நான்} \ta{போவேன்}} — \emph{aṭutta vāram nāṉ pōvēṉ} — \textquotedblleft{}I will go next week.\textquotedblright{}
